paite: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Israel suante houpih inla, a kianga uah, Min bang hiampoimoh tuam tungthu-a thu achiamleh a mihing na seh hun bangin TOUPA atuam ahi ding.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man makes a vow, the persons shall be for Yahweh by your valuation.

paite: Pasal a hih leh na seh dan ding kum sawmnih akipana kum sawmguka upa mun siangthou sekel bang, dangka sekel sawmnga hu ahi ding.
english: Your valuation shall be of a male from twenty years old even to sixty years old, even your valuation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

paite: Numei a hih leh na seh dan ding sekel swmthum ahi ding.
english: If it is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.

paite: Huan, kum nga akipana kum sawmniha upa ahihleh, na seh dan ding pasal sekel sawmnih numei bel sekel sawm ahi ding.
english: If the person is from five years old even to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

paite: Huan, kha khat akipana kum ngaa upa ahihleh, na seh dan ding pasal bel dangka sekel nga, numei bel dangka sekel thum ahi ding.
english: If the person is from a month old even to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.

paite: Huan, kum sawmguk akipan a tunglam a hihleh, na seh dan ding pasal bel sekel sawm leh nga, numei bel sekel sawm ahi ding.
english: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if it is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

paite: Ahihhangin na seh sanga a gentheih leh siampu kiangah pi ding ahi dia, siampuin a nasep ding; thuchiammi zoh hun bang bang saimpuin a nasep ding.
english: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to the ability of him who vowed shall the priest value him.

paite: Huan, thillat, TOUPA kianga a lat ding uh gan a hih leh kuapeuhin TOUPA adia huchibang a piak peuh uh thil siangthou ahi ding ahi.
english: “‘If it is an animal, of which men offer an offering to Yahweh, all that any man gives of such to Yahweh becomes holy.

paite: A hih lamdang ding ahi kei, a sia a phain, a sia a hoih khen ding ahi sam kei: gan gan maha a khen teitei leh a nihin a khenna toh thil siangthou ahi ding ahi.
english: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy.

paite: Huan, gan siangthou lou, TOUPA kianga lat ngei louh chi a hih leh, gan pen siampu maa a koih ding ahi;
english: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to Yahweh, then he shall set the animal before the priest;

paite: Huan, siampuin a hoih dan bangin a man hun a nasep ding: nang siampuin na seh dan bangbang ahi jel ding.
english: and the priest shall value it, whether it is good or bad. As you the priest values it, so shall it be.

paite: Ahihhangin a tat nawn taktak sin leh na seh zah munngaa khena mun khat a behlap ding ahi.
english: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.

paite: Huan, min a in TOUPA tuam dia a lat ding leh a hoih leh hoih louh dungjuiin siampuin a seh ding ahi: siampu seh bangbang ahi ding.
english: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to Yahweh, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad: as the priest shall evaluate it, so shall it stand.

paite: Huan, a lanmiin a in pen a tat nawn ding leh a man dinga na seh zah mun ngaa khena mun khat a behlap ding ahi, huchiin amaha ahi nawn ding.
english: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.

paite: Huan min a gama lou akhen TOUPA tuam dinga a lat sin leh na seh dan ding a chi tuh dung jui jelin ahi ding. Barli buh homer khat mun dangka sekel sawmnga man ahi ding.
english: “‘If a man dedicates to Yahweh part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it: the sowing of a homer 1 homer is about 220 litres or 6 bushels of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

paite: A lou pen Jubili kum akipana lat a hih leh na seh bang ahi tou pek ding.
english: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.

paite: Jubili kum nunga a lat a hihleh bel siampuin aman Jubili tun nawnna ding kum dungjui jelin a sep dinga, na seh dan akipana a kiam hun bawl ahi ding.
english: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.

paite: A lanmiin a tat nawn taktak ding leh a man na seh zah mun ngaa khena mun khat a behlap dinga, amaha ahi nawn ding.
english: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.

paite: Lou pen a tat nop louh hiam, mi dang kianga a khot hiam a hih leh tat nawn theih a hita kei ding:
english: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;

paite: Jubili kuma a pawt nawn hunin lou pen TOUPA adia siangthou, amaha tuam siangthou bang ahi, siampu ading ahi ding.
english: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to Yahweh, as a field devoted; it shall be owned by the priests.

paite: Amah gama him hi lou, lou a leisa, min TOUPA kianga a lat leh,
english: “‘If he dedicates to Yahweh a field which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,

paite: Jubili kum tanin na seh dan bangain siampuin a man a seh sak dinga, na seh bangin TOUPA adinga thil siangthou dingin huai niin a piak ding ahi.
english: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to Yahweh.

paite: Huan, Jubili kumin a leina pa, a gamneipa mahin a tang nawn ding.
english: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.

paite: Na seh dan tengtengmun siangthou sekel bang jel ahi ding hi; sekel khat bel gera sawmnih ahi ding.
english: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.

paite: Ahihhangain ganta laka piang masapen, a pian masak pen jiaka TOUPA tuam dinga sehsa peuhmah jaw kumahin a lan ding ahi kei: bawngtal leng belam leng hi heh, TOUPA tuam ahi hi.
english: “‘Only the firstborn among animals, which is made a firstborn to Yahweh, no man may dedicate it; whether an ox or sheep, it is Yahweh’s.

paite: Huan, gan siangthou lou a hih leh na seh dan bangin tat ding ahi dia, ahuan, a mun ngaa khena mun khat a behlap dinga hi; huan, tat ahih keileh, na seh dan banga khot ding ahi.
english: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it: or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.

paite: Ahihhangin min a neih laka bangpeuh, mihing hiin, ganta hiin, a neihsa lou hitaleh, TOUPA kianga a piaksa juak ding ahi keia; tat ding leng ahi kei; tua bang thil peuhmah TOUPA adingin siangthou pen ahi.
english: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing, that a man shall devote to Yahweh of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy to Yahweh.

paite: Kuapeuh si dia vaihawmsak, mihing laka kipana manthatsak ding, tat ding ahi kei, amah sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “‘No one devoted, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death.

paite: Gam sunga sawm-a-khat peuhmah, gamsunga haichi hitaleh, sing gah hitaleh, TOUPA-a ahi; TOUPA adia thil siangthou ahi.
english: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is Yahweh’s. It is holy to Yahweh.

paite: Huan, min a sawm-a-khat a tat nop leh, mun ngaa khena mun khat a behlap ding ahi.
english: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.

paite: Bawng leh belam sawma khat thu-ah, ganvulmi chianga chiamtehsa nangawn leng, a sawmna jel TOUPA adia siangthou ahi ding.
english: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to Yahweh.

paite: Huai gan tuh a hoih hia, hoih lou, a enchian ding ahi kei, a khek ding leng ahi sam kei; a kheka ahihleh, a khek pen leh a khekna pen leng a nih un siangthou ahi ding ua; tat ding ahi kei hi.Hiaite Israel suante dinga TOUPAN Sinai tang Mosi kianga thupiak a piakte ahi uh.
english: He shall not search whether it is good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he changes it at all, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”

paite: Hiaite Israel suante dinga TOUPAN Sinai tang Mosi kianga thupiak a piakte ahi uh.
english: These are the commandments which Yahweh commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.
